name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one DBX workspace: inspect topics, brokers, and consumer lag; search, stream, and produce messages with multi-channel filters and payload decoding; manage offsets, ACLs, and Schema Registry. Read-only by default, with guarded writes and 11 MCP tools for AI automation.
releaseNotes: 2026-09-26/27 代码评审修复批次（2 高危 + 6 中危 + 6 低危全项）：digest 大扫描新增 64MiB 留存字节预算并跳过 valueBase64 通道（合法 maxScanRecords=100000 不再可能把 sidecar 打到 OOM），payload 新增 retentionTruncated 标记；消费池 release 路径字段写入收拢进池锁并新增 -race 并发压测；stdio 改有界增量读行（超限请求不再预缓冲整行）并加每请求 32 并发背压；整数参数严格解析（partition/partitionOffsets/timestampMs 拒绝小数与越界值，绝不静默折算）；Schema Registry 非 2xx 错误体 2KB 截断；消息过滤 key/value 通道免整串拷贝；前端解压全线 16MiB 上限（gzip 计数断流、zstd/snappy 帧头预检、lz4 输出后检），补齐后端防护的镜像缺口；presets 契约四方对齐；confirmToken 在随机源失败时拒绝签发而非回退可预测值；timestampMs=0 前后端同线拒绝。工程面新增方法契约机器守护：methodContract.json 单一事实源 + backend AST/实调 + frontend mock 三方测试（漂移注入演练验证有效）；shared/frontend 五文件补 vendored 来源戳并纳入 validate_repo 检查。Security review fixes (2 high, 6 medium, 6 low): digest scans now cap retained payloads at 64MiB and skip the valueBase64 channel (maxScanRecords=100000 can no longer OOM the sidecar), with a retentionTruncated flag; consume-pool release writes moved under the pool lock with a -race stress test; stdio now reads lines with a bounded accumulator (oversized requests are rejected without buffering the whole line) plus a 32-request concurrency backpressure; integer arguments reject fractional and out-of-range values; Schema Registry error bodies are truncated to 2KB; key/value filter channels match bytes without full copies; frontend decompression is capped at 16MiB across gzip/zstd/snappy/lz4; presets contract aligned on all four surfaces; confirmToken issuance fails hard when the random source fails; timestampMs=0 is rejected end to end. Engineering: a machine-enforced method contract (methodContract.json verified by backend AST/live-call and frontend mock tests, proven by drift injection), and vendored provenance headers on shared/frontend files checked by validate_repo.
